source_access: Public release/distribution unlimited;credit HYCOM Consortium,NRL,COAPS-FSU;actual returned attributes retained.
horizontal_support_policy: Retain every original section/date,all candidate scores/local maxima,no-selection,gate/support-edge and primary-censored cases. Do not retune gates after results or substitute weaker interior profiles. Coastal dry/slope support and a narrow jet resolved by only a few native cells can censor or confound maxima. Geographic directional maxima can be offshore eddies/recirculation rather than attached named currents.
vertical_operator: Frozen connected-layer tracing searches above/below each qualifying0-200m seed on full native0-5000m support with adjacent finite brackets. Keep upper/lower contours,statuses,supported bounds and paired span distinct. Neither selection endpoints,Northern literature450/250m scales,Algerian200m Atlantic-Water meander-layer thickness,eddy depth,instrument range,geostrophic reference pressure,bed nor missing limits are current bottoms. Model span is not physical thickness;no thermal/density/salinity classification or pressure-to-m conversion.
processing_policy: Cloud-only sequential full-section acquisition,selection,threshold diagnosis,audit and tests on one idle CPU. Local metadata/code/source-PDF review/hash retention only;no local ocean-field processing/tests or runtime/UI/browser/server/native/WASM work. Separate source chunks honor unchanged2.5MB file limits.
revision_context: New quarterly partial Northern Mediterranean and Algerian boundary-current sections. Frozen native longitude geometry,component rotation,interval selection,connected layers and bounded exact-read transport are reused in a new source wrapper. Older validated sources/helpers remain unchanged. Opposite frames are explicit;there is no positive surface gate or thermal/water-mass classification.
geometry_provenance: OSW exploratory fixed-longitude sections: Northern Current6,5.25,4.5,3.75,3E ordered westward with respective42-44N,42-44N,42-44N,41.5-43.5N,41-43N gates;Algerian0,2,4,6,8E ordered eastward with35.5-37.5N then36-38N gates. They bracket existing editorial route context but are not extracted axes,widths,errors,dated trajectories or complete current extents.
column_selector: Complete finite native0-200m signed-component integrals,positive integral and qualifying core>10cm/s. Northern Current uses fixed270degree westward;Algerian fixed90degree eastward,held through depth. No positive surface gate,relative surface comparison or thermal gate. Greatest eligible integral wins;first southern native tie. Gate/support-edge winners remain unresolved without weaker interior replacement. Sensitivities5/10/20cm/s each have their own qualifying seed at the same selected column.
temperature_policy: No temperature field retrieval or gate for these cases. Only velocity dataset and coordinates used.
time_scope: March/June/September/December15,2022 00Z quarterly instantaneous probes,not seasonal means,annual bounds,independent observed occupations,December2011 Toulon survey or1997-1998 ELISA replication. Seasonal literature and wind/eddy episodes are separate from2022 diagnoses.
transport_budget: Preflight all40targets from10sections times4exactdates before fields. Reuse frozen3-150native-row/40level geometry,5km nearest-longitude tolerance,20000pairs/patch,250000total pairs and7MBdecoded caps. Retry only an exact failed component/hyperslab on actualNetCDFI/Ofailure,max3attempts with2/5second backoff,while reserving all future first attempts. Never replay successful components. Ledger counts requested/decoded quantities,not wire bytes or physical precision.

current:northern-mediterranean.branch_scope: Partial6-3E southern-France/Gulf-of-Lion-to-northern-Catalan westward-component context. Exclude upstream Corsican feeders/Ligurian basin reach,downstream40.6N bifurcation and Ibiza/Balearic branches,offshore eddies and inferred full Western Mediterranean circulation. Winds can rotate,weaken or fragment the westward jet;fixed270degree is not a curved along-slope axis. Berta2018 regional450m winter/250m summer scales are literature context,not December2011 or2022 paired boundaries,thickness or annual extrema. Narrow25-40km source-width context may be underresolved;native masks/support matter. Do not assign these cases as independent Ligurian segment measurements.

current:algerian.branch_scope: Partial0-8E Algerian along-slope eastward-component context. Exclude western Alboran gyres/transition,detached Algerian Eddies,downstream Sardinian-channel branches and other Mediterranean currents. Eddy interactions can deflect or recirculate the Atlantic-Water path;an eastward maximum does not independently prove attachment/current identity or Atlantic-Water classification. Source200m typical meander-layer thickness is not whole-current thickness or a bottom;deep eddy extent,geostrophic reference pressure and sampling limits are distinct. Historical ELISA/glider surveys do not validate2022 axes. Fixed90degree is not a rotating along-slope frame.

canonical_route_policy: Independent regional connectors between original model sections may be projected later;they do not replace/extrapolate existing upper-limb/surface editorial routes or establish observed seasonal/depth trajectories.
